narrow_meaning: static spatial constraint / small-road exposure proxy; not measured effective width or probability
narrow_priority: stable polygon cross section with unique address candidate
unknown_policy: raw remains NULL; supported class may receive explicit product prior; unsupported/held remains NULL
merge_unknown_policy: motorway/trunk/primary/secondary=0.5; tertiary/local/service=0; link=1; not proof of lane count
operating_scope: ordinary motorcar; static exclusions retained; unsupported time/vehicle/relation/physical holds excluded; no automatic legal clearance
eta_policy: usable OSM parsed speed * 0.7, then corroborated external speed * 0.7, else explicit highway prior; unverified standard mapping candidates never used
training_requires: same feature/scaler version + real displayed candidate set and choice + routing constraint eligibility
parameter_evidence: engineering defaults frozen for this release, not validated universal driver burden cutoffs
lane_scope: OSM way/carriageway; both directions only when that way represents both; never double one-way lanes
lane_fallback: two-way 1:1; other 1 or 2-3:0.5; 4+:0; unknown alley/living:1,local:0.5,major:0; contradictory/conditional:NULL
narrow_fastroad_rule: After raw/geometry width and semantics holds: motorway/trunk + explicit OSM total>=2 + oneway forward/reverse -> narrow_score 0; estimated proxy
review_transition_policy: Reject known unresolved transitions at evaluation and exclude them during candidate search; not a legal prohibition record
child_geometry: facility points in EPSG:5186; Euclidean distance <=100 m; not legal boundary
child_aggregation: whole nearby edge * actual traversal fraction; exact inside-circle traversal supplied separately as diagnostic
